To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the development of regional industrial symbiosis can best be understood by looking at it as an emergent property of a stable intermediate that builds on the capacity for collective regional action, and that is embedded in a larger context that provides the conditions for the development of the stable intermediate.

industrial symbiosis initiatives in the Sloe area and canal zone developed in a relatively autonomous way, but were influenced by developments in the broader social context, and that these industrial symbiosis initiatives are embedded in larger initiatives that can be understood to develop in an autonomous way as well.
industrial symbiosis is a stable intermediate component in the development of industrial systems that is embedded in a larger societal context.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question how industrial symbiosis can become a more stable and self-sustaining phenomenon.
the question how actors build capacity for sustainable regional development.

the question how the development of regional industrial systems can be understood as building on stable intermediate components and the question how the larger context influences the opportunities that these components see for collective action.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the development of sustainable industrial systems is not a linear process of development from one stable intermediate to another, but a complex process that builds on multiple stable intermediate components, and that can be understood as an embedded process that is influenced by a larger social context.
industrial symbiosis is a complex process that is influenced by a large range of actors and factors that are only partly related to the industrial symbiosis itself.

industrial symbiosis is a stable intermediate for the development of industrial systems that are based on the development of stable intermediate components, which in turn are influenced by a larger social context.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the development of a sustainable industrial system is not only a matter of building capacity for collective action, but also a matter of building a shared understanding of the opportunities for collective action.

industrial symbiosis development is a complex process in which actors build on a stable intermediate (i.e. institutional capacity) that can develop autonomously from other stable intermediates, and that is embedded in a larger context that influences the development of the stable intermediates.
industrial symbiosis development is a complex and non-linear process that builds upon stable components and that is embedded in a social context that influences opportunities and barriers.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the development and maintenance of industrial symbiosis is a process of continuous building of institutional capacity for collective action.
industrial symbiosis is an important, but not sufficient condition for the emergence of sustainable regional industrial systems.
the development and success of industrial symbiosis depends on the development of a larger social context, and that this context is not necessarily created by industrial symbiosis itself.
